causal: All earlier activation/probability/logit/state rows equal for changed final token. Raw scores compare visible source columns for causality; masked future scores remain raw and may differ.

profile.attention: span_attention full GQA semantics: FP64 dots and scale to F32 raw scores; FP64 softmax to F32; FP64 context to F32
profile.conv: F32 B*x; oldest-to-current FP64 three-tap sum to F32; F32 C*z; no SiLU
profile.embedding: original tied F32 table, no scaling
profile.projection: original Q4/G64/BF16 reconstruction to F32; independent FP64 fsum dots to F32
profile.residual: ordinary F32 addition, no Gemma clamp
profile.rms: direct BF16 gain widened to F32; FP64 squares/reduction/division/scaling to F32
profile.rotary: independent Decimal80 frequency to FP64 angle/trig; F32 sin/cos, separately rounded F32 products and add/subtract
profile.silu: FP32 exp(-abs), denominator, division, product; separate F32 gating

scope: Independent synthetic scalar reference only; no Rust target, Half, GPU, real model or text qualification
state: Two conv before/after prefix tables [tokens,2,H]; attention Krotary and V prefix snapshots [tokens,KV,capacity,D], inactive positions positive zero. Reference-derived active states use the same numerical gate; source internal suffix identities and later native transaction identities are exact.
target_inactive_kv: Source inactive +0 is initialization convention only. Target numerical comparisons cover valid active prefix; target reset may retain stale invalid tail. Failure/rollback comparisons use actual retained physical before/after bytes, never fabricated target zeros.
